request: Prepare a design lesson testing display theme and battery runtime. Students should critique the old records and specify allocation, controls, measurement and a blank results table without predicting an effect.
objective: Control brightness while comparing display themes using independent devices and a common runtime endpoint.

sources.text: Fictional device-lab log: dark-theme devices at20% brightness ran a median of10 hours; light-theme devices at60% brightness ran6 hours. Device counts and individual runtimes were not retained.

Thirty unused identical model devices are available; each receives either theme and is tested once with a new identical battery. Both themes support either brightness setting. Charge every battery using the same specified full-charge rule; keep screen hardware, network-off state, video loop and room conditions identical.

Record elapsed time from starting the fixed video loop until automatic shutdown, saving device ID, theme, brightness, start/end times and test order. Randomize allocation and run order; an interrupted test is missing, not a zero-hour shutdown. No new trials have been run.
